translationRepairs: He was made consultant on the staff of the right army and marshal of the cloud-banner staff of Prince Yun of Yuzhang, leading his troops to help defend Stone City.
He was made consultant on the staff of the right army and marshal of the Cloud-Banner headquarters of the Prince of Yuzhang, leading his troops to help defend Stone City.
Chinese 豫章王雲麾府司馬 is the Sima of the Yunhui (Cloud-Banner) headquarters of the Prince of Yuzhang; 雲麾 is an office/title, not the prince's personal name Yun.
He was transferred to Consultant of the Right Army and Marshal of the Cloud-Banner staff of Prince Yun of Yuzhang, leading his troops to help garrison Stone City.
He was transferred to Consultant of the Right Army and Marshal of the Cloud-Banner headquarters of the Prince of Yuzhang, leading his troops to help garrison Stone City.
Same error as idiomatic: 雲麾府 is the Cloud-Banner office, not evidence that the prince was named Yun.
When Runan in Wei submitted, Zhigao was ordered to receive the surrender and was granted acting credentials, made general of swift valor, and appointed regional inspector of Ying province.
When Ruyin in Wei submitted, Zhigao was ordered to receive the surrender and was granted acting credentials, made general of swift valor, and appointed regional inspector of Yingzhou.
Chinese 汝陰 is Ruyin, not Runan (汝南); 潁州 is Yingzhou.
When Wei Yin of Runan came over to submit, he was ordered to receive him and was given Acting Credentials, made General of Swift Valor, and Administrator of Ying Province.
When Wei's Ruyin came over to submit, he was ordered to receive it and was given Acting Credentials, made General of Swift Valor, and Regional Inspector of Yingzhou.
Literal invents personal name 'Wei Yin of Runan'; source is place 汝陰 under Wei submitting.
